slots.jd.design-studio.about:
About us and the job
Willow and Ash Studio is a small, owner-run design studio in Portland. We make brand identities, packaging and print work for our clients, and we do that work together in our studio. We are looking for a junior graphic designer to join us on site, help with day-to-day design tasks and learn how a small studio takes a project from first brief to final file.
slots.jd.design-studio.duties:
What the job involves
- Prepare print-ready files for printers, checking bleed, color and fonts before they go out
- Update brand guidelines when a client's identity changes or grows
- Make client revisions carefully and keep track of each version
- Build layouts for print and digital pieces from approved concepts
- Keep project files organized so everyone in the studio can find what they need
slots.jd.design-studio.needs:
What you need
- 2 or more years of experience in graphic design
- A good grasp of typography and color theory
- Experience with photo retouching in Adobe Photoshop
- Solid layout design skills for print and digital work
- Comfort making quick graphics in Canva
- Willingness to work on site in our Portland studio
slots.r1.b1: Designs print layouts that apply brand identity standards consistently, cutting reprint requests by 55 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Updates brand guideline documents and adds motion graphics examples that show how logos and colors should move across channels.
slots.r1.b3: Produces social media graphics from templates built in Adobe InDesign, reducing production time by 35 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Builds packaging mockups and animates product reveals in Adobe After Effects for client presentations.
slots.r1.i1: Works through client revisions on print and digital pieces at Copperfield Services, turning feedback into updated files on schedule.
slots.r1.i2: Creates packaging mockups at Copperfield Services that help clients see how a design will look before it goes to print.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level graphic designer with about 2 years of experience in visual and brand design, using Figma, Canva and motion graphics to produce clear, on-brand work. Takes on small, well-defined parts of a project and delivers them for review by a senior colleague.
slots.summary.2: Visual and brand designer at entry level with about 2 years of experience creating layouts, social graphics and motion graphics. Works in Figma and Canva on focused tasks within larger projects, with a senior colleague reviewing each piece before delivery.
